beats.display_text: Write-on began on November the tenth, the day Anthropic released Fable 5.2. Timelines filled with people pushing it to its limits. One question stuck instead: how do you write more, and more thoughtfully, without handing your thinking to the machine?
This is a short orientation, not a manual. Write-on is meant to bend to the way you think, not the other way round.
But four ideas make it click much faster, especially if your hands already know another editor by heart.
